title: Brutalist monolith
when: Manifestos, campaigns, architecture, sport and hard launches: wide capitals on concrete, pushes and wipes, nothing decorative
rules: Every headline is a block of capitals; the one phrase that matters sits on the marker. Keep headlines to six words so the wide face stays large.
Compose with hard rectangles, rules and the grid: no rounded forms, no glow, no gradients. Colour is a slab of accent behind a number or a word (tone accent) at most twice per minute.
Cut by pushing: every scene arrives from the right or below on the beat; a wipe only where a chapter changes.
Numbers are poster-sized and tabular; one per scene, with its source line in the same grid.
Hold nothing still: the slow camera stays on, type arrives word by word, and plates drift against it.
